text:
sam: Quick check — noticed ArgoCD started reconciling the infra-app before the GHA 'bootstrap-secrets' job finished. Caused a missing k8s secret on first apply. Anyone else seeing this?

kaya: saw it on PR #412 yesterday :grimacing: ArgoCD webhook triggered on push immediately.

jonathan: confirmed. Our GH Action finished the secret upload ~30s after the push event reached ArgoCD. Race condition.

sam: would adding a 'pre-sync fence' help? e.g. GHA writes a lock object (S3) or toggles an App annotation and ArgoCD pre-sync hook waits for it.

meera: I prototyped something lightweight: GHA uploads a tiny 'ready' file to infra-bucket and an ArgoCD pre-sync Job polls S3 up to 2m before allowing sync.

alex: can you paste the GHA step + pre-sync hook you used? :eyes:

meera: sure — gha snippet:
```yaml
- name: upload infra-ready
  run: |
    aws s3 cp - s3://redwood-ci/locks/infra-ready-${{ github.sha }}
    # mark done
```

pre-sync hook (k8s Job container):
```bash
for i in {1..12}; do
  if aws s3 ls s3://redwood-ci/locks/infra-ready-${GIT_SHA}; then exit 0; fi
  sleep 10
done
exit 1
```

kaya: this fixes the race but feels hacky (relying on S3 eventual consistency). Another option: GH Action calls ArgoCD API to pause reconciliation on the App, run bootstrap, then unpause.

jonathan: pause/unpause via ArgoCD API works and is pretty direct, but you need to manage tokens and ensure unpause always runs (even on failures). We should be careful to avoid leaving apps paused.

sam: also consider Atlantis flow — TF apply from Atlantis may cause a commit that triggers the same race. The lock needs to be visible to both gha runs and atlantis hooks.

alex: agreed. If Atlantis does the apply and then pushes manifests, it should also create the same 'lock' artifact or call the same pause API. Otherwise we still have races.

meera: proposal: centralize on an 'infra-locks' S3 prefix (or small dynamo entry) keyed by commit/PR. Both GHA and Atlantis post lock before making the manifest commit. ArgoCD pre-sync reads that key. Add a short TTL cleanup (lambda) and metrics.

kaya: +1. Also add a dedicated metric (infra.lock.created / infra.lock.missing) so we can alert if locks pile up. infra-bot could emit an event when locks are created/removed.

infra-bot: (automated) created ticket INFRA-742: "argocd pre-sync fence + gha/atlantis lock protocol" — https://tickets/redwood/INFRA-742 :memo:

meera: I'll open a PR to add the gha step, a small lambda for TTL cleanup, and an ArgoCD pre-sync Job template (staging only to start). I'll also add a unimetrics counter for locks.

jonathan: please prototype on staging infra-app first. Once stable we can roll to prod via canary.

sam: action items: meera = prototype + PR, alex = verify Atlantis post-apply hook, kaya = infra-bot metrics/alerts. Target: staging prototype by EOD Friday.

sam: tagging @meera @alex @kaya

meera: noted :+1:
